mapper.sql: WITH events AS (SELECT e.*,i.unit,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.product_id ORDER BY e.event_at DESC,e.sale_item_id DESC) snapshot_rank FROM v_sale_event e JOIN sale_item i ON i.id=e.sale_item_id WHERE ), totals AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(signed_qty) net_qty,SUM(signed_amount) net_amount FROM events GROUP BY product_id)
